messages:
mara: Heads up — NimbusHealth (acct:nimbus-123) flagged invoice INV-2026-047 for a large Dedicated burst overage. They say the burst line looks double-charged. Attaching their email and invoice screenshot. :eyes:
invoice-bot: Invoice INV-2026-047 generated 2026-03-29 08:12 UTC — total_due $18,450 — link: https://billing.redwood/invoices/INV-2026-047
samir: Can you paste the billed usage lines? need to check committed vs burst math before contacting them.
natalie: Quick summary from contract: committed 50k tokens/month at reserved commit. Billing export shows total tokens 180k for period (so burst billed for 130k). BUT invoice burst line reads 260k tokens billed. That looks like duplication. :thinking_face:
eli: Possible double-count in aggregator when retries happened across AZs. I'll pull usage export now and sample the raw events.
eli: sample from billing export (sanitized):
```
timestamp,customer_id,plan,metric,tokens
2026-03-05T02:11:14Z,nimbus-123,dedicated,committed,50000
2026-03-29T07:59:02Z,nimbus-123,dedicated,burst,130000
2026-03-29T07:59:05Z,nimbus-123,dedicated,burst,130000  # duplicate event due to retry
```
mara: If that's the case we should issue a corrective invoice and an SLA credit for the erroneous overage. Estimate of erroneous charge ~ $7,200 (provisional). Need finance lead sign-off for credits > $5k. @samir can you confirm customer communication?
samir: I'll tell NimbusHealth we're investigating and will provisionally pause collection on INV-2026-047. I'll propose a provisional credit of $7,200 and promise a corrected invoice within 48 hours.
natalie: Customer asks for an interim proforma credit note they can share with procurement. I'll draft it once finance approves.
eli: Root cause: billing-processor created non-idempotent burst events when downstream ack failed. Patch rolled: kubectl rollout restart deploy/billing-processor -n prod. I'll reprocess deduped usage and push new export to s3://billing-exports/2026/03/nimbus-123-corrected.csv by EOD.
mara: Approve provisional credit $7,200 pending final recon and processed usage export. Please tag ledger entry GC-2026-048 and block any collection attempts until final invoice.
samir: Confirmed. I'll attach GC-2026-048 to the customer thread and send proforma.
invoice-bot: Invoice INV-2026-047 status updated -> credit_pending (refer: TICKET-5324).

mara: Thanks team — once eli confirms corrected export, finance will post the final credit and reissue invoice. Natalie, please keep NimbusHealth updated and aim to close the loop within 48 hours. :thumbsup:
